statement: There is a smooth double cover Y → K = Km(B′), with K the resolved Kummer surface, satisfying the following assertions. (i) The anti-invariant lattice V = H2 (Y, Z)δ=−1 (with torsion removed) is even, has signature (2, 14), and has 2-elementary discriminant group. For fixed (B, M, χ), monodromy acts trivially on this discriminant group. 16 OPENAI (ii) There are eight mutually orthogonal algebraic anti-invariant classes a1, . . . , a8, each of square −4. Their perpendicular U = ⟨a1, . . . , a8⟩⊥ ⊂ VQ is a Hodge structure of signature (2, 6) and, with the intersection form inherited from Y , is rationally isometric to VP = (U ⊕ U(2) ⊕ D4(−1))Q. (iii) Resolved pullback gives a flat Hodge isomorphism β : U ∼ − → UX with (βx, βy)X = 2(x, y)Y . The algebraic projector (3.2) e = 1 4 (∆X + Γj − Γδ − Γjδ) ∈ CH2 (X × X)Q has image UX in degree two and is zero in every other degree. The constructions are compatible with variation on the indicated smooth parameter opens.
